old: They took the dead away, each man buried his own dead, and put the bodies
new: They took the dead away, each man burying his own, and put the bodies
reason: Edit access#22 put an independent clause ("each man buried his own dead") inside Butler's series of verbs for "They" (took … buried … put). The result is a comma splice, and "and put the bodies" now attaches to "each man". Butler: "They took the dead away, buried every man his own, and put the bodies…". An absolute phrase keeps Butler's structure and meaning and drops the repeated "dead".
